defect_location.description: CVE-2019-8457: rtreenode() 处理无效 rtree 表时堆越界读（CVE 描述: heap out-of-bound read in the rtreenode() function when handling invalid rtree tables, CWE-125）。

source.simplification: 剥离 SQLite rtree 模块，保留『单元数与节点缓冲大小不一致时循环读越界』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: rtree 节点缓冲仅含 2 个单元，头部声明的单元数为 9 → 循环读越界
notes: CVE-2019-8457: rtreenode() 处理无效 rtree 表时堆越界读（CVE 描述: heap out-of-bound read in the rtreenode() function when handling invalid rtree tables, CWE-125）。
